entries.title: I John 5:1
segments: ¶Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves Him who begot also loves him who is begotten of Him.

entries.title: I John 5:2
segments: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep His commandments.

entries.title: I John 5:3
segments: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome.

entries.title: I John 5:4
segments: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world--our faith.

entries.title: I John 5:5
segments: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

entries.title: I John 5:6
segments: ¶This is He who came by water and blood--Jesus Christ; not only by water, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who bears witness, because the Spirit is truth.

entries.title: I John 5:7
segments: For there are three that bear witness in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one.

entries.title: I John 5:8
segments: And there are three that bear witness on earth: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and these three agree as one.

entries.title: I John 5:9
segments: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is the witness of God which He has testified of His Son.

entries.title: I John 5:10
segments: ¶He who believes in the Son of God has the witness in himself; he who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he has not believed the testimony that God has given of His Son.

entries.title: I John 5:11
segments: And this is the testimony: that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.

entries.title: I John 5:12
segments: He who has the Son has life; he who does not have the Son of God does not have life.

entries.title: I John 5:13
segments: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may [continue to] believe in the name of the Son of God.

entries.title: I John 5:14
segments: ¶Now this is the confidence that we have in Him, that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

entries.title: I John 5:15
segments: And if we know that He hears us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we have asked of Him.

entries.title: I John 5:16
segments: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin [which does] not [lead] to death, he will ask, and He will give him life for those who commit sin not [leading] to death. There is sin [leading] to death. I do not say that he should pray about that.

entries.title: I John 5:17
segments: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not [leading] to death.

entries.title: I John 5:18
segments: ¶We know that whoever is born of God does not sin; but he who has been born of God keeps himself, and the wicked one does not touch him.

entries.title: I John 5:19
segments: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies [under the sway of] the wicked one.

entries.title: I John 5:20
segments: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true, in His Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

entries.title: I John 5:21
segments: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
